title_blacklist.note: Hard-filter in prepare-digest.js BEFORE sending to LLM. Matched case-insensitively as substrings against item.title. Cuts ~50% of noise on 9to5Mac/Verge feeds.

scarcity_taxonomy.note: Top Signals selection rubric. Each Top Signals item MUST be labeled with exactly one category from `categories`, assigned a frequency anchor (`annual`/`quarterly`/`monthly`), and scored as `base_score × anchor_weight`. LLM only does category+anchor matching — it does NOT need historical knowledge (categories define scarcity, not LLM memory). Revise quarterly based on dogfooding.

anchor_definitions.annual: Once-a-year or rarer event within this category (e.g., FDA's first consumer-grade AFib clearance for a wearable — happens at most once a year globally).
anchor_definitions.quarterly: Few-per-year event within this category (e.g., a major vendor's new regulatory clearance in a new jurisdiction).
anchor_definitions.monthly: Routine-but-still-notable within this category (e.g., another vendor achieving a similar clearance that's already established).

categories.criteria: FDA 510(k) / De Novo / PMA, CE mark MDR, NMPA certification, PMDA, TGA — for a wearable health feature. Peer-reviewed multi-site prospective clinical validation also qualifies.
examples_positive: Apple Watch gets FDA clearance for new sleep apnea detection
Samsung Health Monitor BP approved in US
Oura ring NMPA class-II certification
examples_negative: Another vendor clones an already-approved feature in a new region (→ monthly anchor, not annual)

categories.criteria: Vendor or academic publicly releases model weights, pretrained foundation model, large labeled dataset, or production-grade SDK/code for wearable/physiological signals. Must be usable (not just a paper claiming 'code coming soon').
examples_positive: Meta releases wearable foundation model weights on HuggingFace
Stanford/Apple release 1M-ECG labeled dataset
Google open-sources Fitbit sleep staging model
examples_negative: Academic paper promises code release but repo is empty

categories.criteria: M&A, major exec/founder departure or appointment at a wearable company, large funding round (≥$50M), strategic pivot announcement. Affects competitive landscape or talent flow.
examples_positive: Google acquires Oura
Shwetak Patel leaves Google Health for X startup
WHOOP pivots from consumer to B2B-clinical

categories.criteria: Consumer wearable first-time integration of a physical/biochemical sensing modality (non-invasive BP, non-invasive glucose, EMG, sweat cortisol, SpHb, real-time hydration, etc.). Must ship in a real product, not just a research paper.
examples_positive: Samsung ships first consumer non-invasive glucose on Galaxy Watch
Apple adds wrist-based cuffless BP to Series X
Oura integrates continuous sweat-lactate sensor
examples_negative: New optical HR sensor iteration in existing form factor (already-done modality)
Academic prototype for a new sensor — belongs in algorithmic_breakthrough or open_release if qualifying

categories.criteria: New SOTA with concrete metric on wearable/physiological task, OR foundation-model / self-supervised training at ≥10M-sample scale, OR on-device breakthrough with specific latency/size/power numbers. Must have reproducible evidence (paper with code, benchmark result).
examples_positive: ECG foundation model at 11M samples with systematic SSL comparison (example)
On-device AFib detection at <5ms/inference on Apple S10 chip
New sleep-stage SOTA on SHHS with 3pp gain
examples_negative: Incremental +1pp gain with cherry-picked test set

categories.criteria: Prospective or multi-site clinical study with n≥10,000 participants OR multi-center design, wearable-derived endpoint, peer-reviewed or at top conference.
examples_positive: Ultrahuman Ring N=3086 longitudinal sleep study (today's example — note: n<10k but near-threshold + longitudinal design keeps it in this category at monthly anchor)
All of Us cohort wearable analysis n>50k
Apple Heart Study n=419k

categories.criteria: Wearable vendor first-time entry into new go-to-market category: clinical services, B2B/B2B2C, insurance, subscription, EHR integration, pharma partnership. Must be a real product launch, not a trial balloon.
examples_positive: WHOOP launches clinician video visits + HealthEx EHR integration (today's example)
Oura partners with large insurer for reimbursed rings
Apple Watch Atrial Fibrillation History gets CMS reimbursement code
examples_negative: New subscription tier of existing product

categories.criteria: HealthKit / Health Connect / Samsung Health SDK / Huawei Health Kit / Wear OS schema, new data type, permission, or interoperability standard (FHIR wearables profile). Must be shipping, not WWDC keynote hype.
examples_positive: HealthKit adds glucose trend data type in watchOS 27
Health Connect adds cross-app mental-health schema
New IEEE standard for wearable data exchange ratified
